description: Builds attestation_refresher.py daemon per spec Appendix A. Nightly job that finds mcp_attestations where validity_days remaining <7 or where underlying signals have changed since attestation created_at. Regenerates attestation text referencing current signal scores. Uses write_service POST :8772/query to find candidates, POST :8772/execute to update. Does NOT drop or delete rows. Must write heartbeat to service_health every 60s. Include check_single_instance PID guard. Service name: attestation_refresher, port: none (daemon). Read spec section 4 for freshness SLA details.
